tasks.spec: You are a trivial placeholder worker for a billed live run that Ringer's check performs itself. Boundary: do NOT run any bench command, do NOT call any model or network service, do NOT touch any file except the one you own, never git commit. Your only job: write the single line 'ready live-control-r1' into the file /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/live-control-r1-ready.txt (create it; the directory exists). Nothing else is needed; the check afterwards runs replicate 1 of the CONTROL arm of experiment L, path A (.plans/shared-narrator-instruction-conflicts-prereg.md) and writes its records under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1. Do not read or edit anything else.
tasks.check:
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/shared-narrator-control-tree || exit 1
export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/shared-narrator-control-tree:/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/shared-narrator-control-tree/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ ! -e /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1/summary.json ] || { echo 'output already exists; refusing to re-bill'; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live
.venv/bin/python -m bench run --variation bench/variations/richer-3a-live.json --scene 3A --script richer-3a-detention --replicates 1 --out /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1 --confirm > /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1.log 2>&1
rc=$?
tail -6 /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1.log
[ -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1/summary.json ] && [ -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1/all-turn-records.json ] || { echo "WHY: bench wrote no records (rc=$rc)"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY2'
import json
s = json.load(open('/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/shared-narrator/live/control-r1/summary.json'))
print({k: s.get(k) for k in ('failed_replicates', 'completed_replicates', 'failure_reason') if k in s})
print(s.get('budget'))
PY2
exit 0
tasks.verified: the replay wrote every row (errors kept as rows)
